Container.Name: park-map
Container.Overview: Map of US Parks on the Air parks with their real boundaries, plus SOTA summits and their activation zones. Filter to spots where you can activate two, three or more parks at once (n-fers), and click anywhere to see every park and summit at that point. Park outlines come from USGS PAD-US; activation zones are © sotl.as contributors.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Satellite gateway settings (mail, SOTA login) and its log.

Config.Name: Settings password
Config.Description: Password for the settings page and log (user name can be anything). Leave empty only if your network is private.
